location_description: Tempe ( tem-PEE;) is a city in Maricopa County, Arizona, United States, with the Census Bureau reporting a 2020 population of 180,587.  The city is named after the Vale of Tempe in Greece. Tempe is located in the East Valley section of metropolitan Phoenix; it is bordered by Phoenix and Guadalupe on the west, Scottsdale and the Salt River Pima–Maricopa Indian Community on the north, Chandler on the south, and Mesa on the east.
